## Linked Issue

Refs #1895

## Scope Summary

Implement R07 in `src/frontend/src/components/admin/SecurityDashboardWorkbench.vue` only.

Replace the native security refresh button with the existing public `FsusUiButton` export from `@/fsusui/button`, which re-exports real `ElButton`. Preserve explicit `native-type="button"`, `:disabled="loading"`, loading/idle copy, and the exact zero-payload `$emit('refresh')` expression. Checked-time/data presentation, ARIA, security model and handlers are unchanged.

Remove the refresh selectors from copied generic control/hover/focus styling and remove its custom disabled styling. Preserve the RouterLink action styling and the mobile refresh grid placement. No new wrapper, fallback, private DOM query, component-ref cast, registry, tests, receipt, frozen evidence, or shared-file changes.

Candidate binding:
- Base branch: `codex/r07-security-workbench-base-d5773ef9`
- Base SHA: `d5773ef97f55176a1eab67e677790f3e13352a7b`
- Head branch: `codex/r07-security-workbench-refresh`
- Head SHA: `672388e5c19efff36db3a668eb1f41238194c353`
- Parent of head equals the requested base; exactly one commit and one changed production file.
- Original owned blob: `654883a16aa34e8bc6a11c3c74735fa776766b4b`
- Candidate owned blob: `65948a7fe8da5f5bb974f0741fc8ce7f076334f9`
- Active local UI961 source: `/workspace/FsusUI-ui961`, clean tracked tree at `c77281165226ffd84223c4c8d43805c5deb2b1b3`.
- Environment-provided Bash, git, Node/npm and installed vue-tsc are available. Initial default checkouts differed from the requested revisions; isolated worktrees preserve both original checkouts.

## Change Classification

- [x] Behavior change
- [ ] Format-only
- [ ] Naming-only
- [ ] Generated output
- [ ] Public contract change
- [ ] External naming exception
- Contract impact: compatible

Consumer-only prescribed primitive adoption on the admin task surface. Business semantics are preserved; generic control appearance/focus/disabled behavior now comes from the public primitive. This is implementation evidence, not UX acceptance.

## Tests Run

- [ ] `./tools/test.sh fast` — prohibited by this delegation; HOLD.
- [ ] Targeted backend tests: not run; outside scope.
- [x] Targeted frontend checks: original complete local-source application typecheck, original complete lint, and diff checks run on base and candidate; failures retained.
- [x] Other: exact log/diagnostic comparison and one-file Git diff inspection.

Commands, without reduced projects, mocks, skips or configuration edits:

```bash
# From repository root, on both base and candidate:
FSUSBLOG_USE_LOCAL_FSUSUI=1 FSUSBLOG_LOCAL_FSUSUI_ROOT=/workspace/FsusUI-ui961 \
  node src/frontend/scripts/run-local-fsusui-typecheck.mjs --application

# From src/frontend, on both base and candidate:
FSUSBLOG_USE_LOCAL_FSUSUI=1 FSUSBLOG_LOCAL_FSUSUI_ROOT=/workspace/FsusUI-ui961 \
  npm run lint:full

# Base and candidate working-tree checks, plus final commit comparison:
git diff --check
git diff --check d5773ef97f55176a1eab67e677790f3e13352a7b 672388e5c19efff36db3a668eb1f41238194c353
```

The unmodified existing local-alias producer extends complete `tsconfig.app.json` without an include override. It resolves `@ozwasyd/element-plus` to the actual UI961 public `vue/packages/element-plus/index.ts`. Its generated config SHA-256 is `f1369043e8e92aa844ddad714fa9ce504c4efa914370ff38cec0e9aa7eb3018c`.

| Original static check | Base | Candidate | Comparison |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Complete local application typecheck | FAIL, exit 2, 29 TS diagnostics | FAIL, exit 2, 29 TS diagnostics | Byte-identical logs |
| Complete lint | FAIL, exit 1, 83,667 diagnostic lines | FAIL, exit 1, 83,667 diagnostic lines | Byte-identical logs; zero added/removed diagnostics; owned file has zero diagnostics in both |
| Diff whitespace check | PASS, exit 0 | PASS, exit 0 | Final base/head diff also passes |

Complete typecheck failures include existing upload endpoint/POD identity errors, the unused Analytics ref, and UI961 unused-variable/erasable-syntax diagnostics. Complete lint retains existing stale baseline configuration/source-state/generatedFrom failures and all repository-wide findings. None was repaired, suppressed, reclassified or turned into a pass.

Supporting logs remain in the execution environment under `/tmp/fsusblog-r07/`; they are not committed evidence or qualification receipts:
- `base-typecheck.log` and `candidate-typecheck.log`: SHA-256 `bd7cac17210000159ce512a3f2128aaa4fb125b40007c1937f8f9eb26f482e30`
- `base-lint-ui961.log` and `candidate-lint-ui961.log`: SHA-256 `1a372b6010e60347004476cc6c7ab3ec8c65688767afc9e2378ab5958cb8117d`
- `static-comparison.json`, exit-code files, and `implementation.patch` provide the local comparison.
- The first lint attempt lacked its configured toolchain; the first dependency install failed because the default npm cache was unwritable. The unchanged pinned style toolchain installed successfully with `npm ci --ignore-scripts --cache /tmp/fsusblog-r07/npm-cache --prefix tools/frontend/style-toolchain`. An additional early full lint used the environment's original UI source; that failure is retained separately and is not the UI961 comparison above.

No tests/list/discovery, product/module execution, browser, native, DB, or qualification command was run.

- [x] Accessibility and reduced-motion impact considered — existing ARIA and button semantics preserved in source; runtime acceptance remains HOLD.

UI961's public Button documentation exposes its HTML element through `ref`; the source forwards the actual MouseEvent. This component has no element-ref/focus handler, so no new ref handling is needed.

## Notes For Reviewers

All checked documentation/intent/lifecycle items were reviewed as not applicable to a source-document edit: no public API, security model, wire/ABI, database, permissions, schema, performance claim, generated output or normative document semantics changed. No TODO/FIXME was added. No broad formatting migration occurred, so formatter idempotence and blame-ignore updates are not applicable.

The task authorizes only the owned production file; no other task's file was edited. No receipts or frozen evidence were created or modified. Repository design Skills and active public Button contracts were consulted; their broader rendered and independent acceptance requirements remain HOLD under the delegation's explicit static-only restriction.

This draft intentionally targets a task-owned branch fixed at the requested baseline rather than the moving master. It does not close #1895, authorize merging, publish a package, or claim readiness.
